---
title: "About Me"
---

I am a senior HBSc student at the University of Toronto (UTSC), pursuing a **Physics and Mathematics Specialist** with a **Minor in Statistics** (former Biochemistry Major). My academic journey is driven by how mathematical structures underpin the physical world and how computational tools model complex systems.

## Background

- **Mathematical Analysis:** Real & Complex Analysis, Functional Analysis, Topology, Axiomatic Set Theory
- **Modeling:** ODE/PDE, Stochastic Processes, Convex & Linear Optimization, Numerical Methods
- **Scientific Computing:** Python (NumPy, SciPy, Pandas), R, MATLAB
- **Physics:** Quantum Mechanics, Electrodynamics, Classical Mechanics, Thermal Physics
- **Life Sciences:** Biochemistry, Genetics, Molecular Biology, Organic Chemistry

Beyond the classroom I am a software enthusiast. I build full-stack web applications, automated pipelines, developer tools, and interactive visualizations. I enjoy translating complex scientific concepts into interactive code.
